definitions.explanation: A number of people or things gathered together.

examples.japanese: {集団|しゅうだん}で{行動|こうどう}する。
{集団|しゅうだん}{生活|せいかつ}に{慣|な}れる。
examples.english: To get used to group living.

examples.japanese: {集団|しゅうだん}{心理|しんり}というものは{恐|おそ}ろしい。{普段|ふだん}は{理性的|りせいてき}な{人|ひと}でも、{集団|しゅうだん}の{中|なか}では{冷静|れいせい}な{判断|はんだん}ができなくなることがある。
examples.english: Group psychology is frightening. Even normally rational people can lose their ability to make calm judgments when in a group.

notes:
{集団|しゅうだん} refers to a group or collective of people or things.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {集団|しゅうだん}{行動|こうどう} (group action)
- {集団|しゅうだん}{生活|せいかつ} (group living)
- {集団|しゅうだん}{心理|しんり} (group/mob psychology)
- {集団|しゅうだん}{訴訟|そしょう} (class action lawsuit)
- {集団|しゅうだん}{感染|かんせん} (cluster infection)
- {集団|しゅうだん}{登校|とうこう} (walking to school in groups)
- {武装|ぶそう}{集団|しゅうだん} (armed group)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {集団|しゅうだん}: group, collective (formal, often larger)
- グループ: group (casual, smaller)
- {団体|だんたい}: organization, group (organized with purpose)
- {群|む}れ: crowd, flock (less organized)
